      _ = b := (h b a a (c ◇ ((a ◇ c) ◇ b))).symm
  have hright : ∀ a b c : G, a ◇ (c ◇ b) = b := by
    intro a b c
    calc
      a ◇ (c ◇ b) = a ◇ (b ◇ ((c ◇ b) ◇ ((c ◇ (c ◇ b)) ◇ b))) := congrArg (fun t => a ◇ t) (h (c ◇ b) b c b)
      _ = b := (h b a c ((c ◇ (c ◇ b)) ◇ b)).symm
  have hall : ∀ a b : G, a = b := by
    intro a b
    exact (hleft a a b).symm.trans (hright a b a)
  exact hall x (y ◇ (((z ◇ x) ◇ x) ◇ y))
